full_text: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
explanation: Applies to dishonest taking of movable property out of possession of any person without consent.
essential_ingredients: Dishonest intention to take movable property
Property taken out of possession of another person
Absence of that person's consent
Moving of property in order to effect such taking
penalty_text: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.
source_gazette: The Gazette of India Extra-Ordinary No. 45 of 2023

section_title: Rash driving or riding on a public way
full_text: Whoever drives any vehicle, or rides, on any public way in a manner so rash or negligent as to endanger human life, or to be likely to cause hurt or injury to any other person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both.
explanation: Applies to motor vehicle incidents involving high speed, rash driving, or contraband smuggling escape driving on public highways.
essential_ingredients: Driving a vehicle on a public way
Manner of driving is rash or negligent
Endangering human life or likely to cause bodily hurt
penalty_text: Imprisonment up to 6 months or fine up to Rs. 1,000 or both.
source_gazette: The Gazette of India Extra-Ordinary No. 45 of 2023

full_text: Whoever causes the death of any person by doing any rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to five years, and shall also be liable to fine.
explanation: Applied to fatal road traffic accidents or death caused through negligent transport or operations.
essential_ingredients: Death of a human being occurred
Act of accused was rash or negligent
Act did not amount to culpable homicide
penalty_text: Imprisonment up to 5 years and fine.
source_gazette: The Gazette of India Extra-Ordinary No. 45 of 2023

full_text: Whoever voluntarily causes hurt to any person shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both.
explanation: Applies when physical bodily pain, disease, or infirmity is caused intentionally during an assault or scuffle.
essential_ingredients: Bodily pain, disease or infirmity caused to a person
Act was done with intention or knowledge of causing hurt
penalty_text: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs. 10,000, or both.
source_gazette: The Gazette of India Extra-Ordinary No. 45 of 2023

full_text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
explanation: Applicable to intentional causing of death or fatal bodily injury known to be sufficient in the ordinary course of nature to cause death.
essential_ingredients: Death of a person caused by the accused
Intention of causing death or bodily injury sufficient to cause death
Absence of general exceptions (e.g. sudden provocation)
penalty_text: Death or Imprisonment for life, and fine.
source_gazette: The Gazette of India Extra-Ordinary No. 45 of 2023

section_title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
full_text: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to make, alter or destroy the whole or any part of a valuable security, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
explanation: Applies to fraudulent sales, bogus permit certificates, or financial embezzlement in liquor trade.
essential_ingredients: Deception of any person
Fraudulent or dishonest inducement to deliver property
Damage or harm caused to that person
penalty_text: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.
source_gazette: The Gazette of India Extra-Ordinary No. 45 of 2023

full_text: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than ten years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
explanation: Severe sexual offence provision under BNS; requires strict privacy protection of victim details and separate sensitive handling.
essential_ingredients: Sexual acts falling within statutory definitions of Section 63
Absence of valid, free consent or obtained under fear, intoxication, or misconception
Victim identity strictly protected from public disclosure
penalty_text: Rigorous imprisonment for 10 years to Life, and fine.
source_gazette: The Gazette of India Extra-Ordinary No. 45 of 2023
